# basename

Print the final component of a path through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/basename /home/user/report.txt

moonx cli/basename -s .txt reports/first.txt reports/second.txt
```

A second operand removes a literal suffix. Use -a for multiple names; -s also enables multiple-name mode.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-a`, `--multiple` | Process each operand separately. |
| `-s VALUE`, `--suffix VALUE` | Remove a matching suffix; implies multiple operands. |
| `-z`, `--zero` | End each result with NUL. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

- Paths are handled lexically; files do not need to exist.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
